verdict.rationale: The POS features page says Sidekick, Shopify's AI assistant, gives reordering suggestions based on sales velocity and seasonality. It also recommends stock transfers between locations based on performance trends and can create them automatically. That is AI-generated, data-driven insight and action within the product. missing for 10: evidence of AI insights beyond inventory (e.g., sales or customer analytics), in-depth help-center documentation of Sidekick within the POS app itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.
